# Click.n.likes

> Full-stack organic growth agency for SaaS, manufacturers, legal and professional firms, D2C brands and local businesses worldwide. SEO, AI Search, Social, Content, Websites and Paid.

Based in Ahmedabad, India, working with clients worldwide. Every score our free tools show is either a live, verifiable measurement (labelled "verified") or a self-reported answer (labelled as such) - never blended or presented as more certain than it is. Pricing is published on the site, not gated behind a sales call.

## Services

- [SEO (Organic & On-Page)](https://clicknlikes.com/services/seo/): Keyword strategy, on-page optimization, technical fixes and supporting blog content, built around how your category actually gets searched on Google: separate from Google Maps/Local, which we treat as its own discipline.
- [Local SEO & Google Business](https://clicknlikes.com/services/local-seo/): Google Business Profile optimization, review strategy and local link building: the Google Maps / "local pack" discipline, run separately from organic SEO because it's won with a different set of signals.
- [AI SEO & AI Overviews](https://clicknlikes.com/services/ai-seo/): Search is splitting into two tracks: blue links and AI answers. We structure your content, schema and entity signals so AI engines cite you, not your competitor.
- [Social Media Growth](https://clicknlikes.com/services/social-media-growth/): Strategy, calendars, captions and creative direction for Instagram and LinkedIn, aimed at DMs and bookings, not just likes.
- [Content Marketing](https://clicknlikes.com/services/content-marketing/): Blogs, guides, landing page copy and case studies, written to a structure that both search engines and AI models can actually extract answers from.
- [Website Development](https://clicknlikes.com/services/website-development/): Fast, mobile-first websites built on top of the same SEO and content strategy that drives your traffic, so the site is never a separate project from your growth.
- [Paid Campaigns](https://clicknlikes.com/services/paid-campaigns/): Meta and Google campaigns layered on top of SEO and content that's already working, so every rupee of ad spend compounds instead of disappearing the day you stop paying.

## Free Tools

Live, real scans - not lead-gen quizzes. Each shows a score on screen for free; the full breakdown is emailed.

- [Website Health Scan](https://clicknlikes.com/tools/): A live 11-signal on-page SEO audit of your page.
- [Website Speed Test](https://clicknlikes.com/tools/website-speed/): Your real mobile load speed, in plain English.
- [First-Impression Snapshot](https://clicknlikes.com/tools/first-impression/): See your homepage the way a new visitor does.
- [Funnel Leak & ROI](https://clicknlikes.com/tools/funnel-roi/): The revenue you leak below a healthy 3% conversion.
- [Competitor Threat](https://clicknlikes.com/tools/competitor-threat/): Score how much of a threat your main rival really is.
- [Schema Markup Generator & Checker](https://clicknlikes.com/tools/schema-generator/): Score what you have, then generate what is missing, pre-filled from your page.
- [Schema Validator & Score](https://clicknlikes.com/tools/schema-validator/): Score your schema, see what each gap costs you, generate the fix.
- [Content SEO Score](https://clicknlikes.com/tools/content-score/): Score one page of content on real on-page SEO fundamentals.

## Work

- [AidByLaw: From ads-dependent to a second channel that pays for itself](https://clicknlikes.com/work/aidbylaw/): A Pan-India legal consultation platform came to us wanting leads. Thirteen months later they had a scaled paid channel and an organic one built from zero.
- [Adamas Films: A dark, cinematic home for a reel that already speaks for itself](https://clicknlikes.com/work/adamas-films/): A Mumbai production house that shoots for Disney, Viacom18, Star and Zee needed a website with the same restraint as its work. We built one from scratch.
- [Kopa Seamless: One self-built page, and organic search became the lead engine](https://clicknlikes.com/work/kopa-seamless/): A Mumbai apparel manufacturer built their own one-page site and asked us for SEO only. It now drives most of their new leads.

## Insights

- [How do I know if my site's slow load speed is actually costing me leads?](https://clicknlikes.com/insights/slow-speed-costing-leads/): Speed loss is invisible by nature, nobody who leaves in three seconds ever writes to tell you why, but it is measurable if you know where to look.
- [Service-area business vs. storefront: does local SEO work differently?](https://clicknlikes.com/insights/service-area-vs-storefront/): Plumbers, electricians and consultants who visit the customer play a different local SEO game than a clinic with a front door, and treating them the same costs both.
- [What should a website cost, and what should be included?](https://clicknlikes.com/insights/website-cost-checklist/): Real 2026 India pricing, freelancer through agency, plus the checklist of what a proper build should never bill you as an extra.
- [What's a realistic timeline to grow a following that actually converts?](https://clicknlikes.com/insights/social-growth-timeline/): Followers move first and fastest; enquiries lag behind them by design, and knowing the real shape of that gap stops a working strategy from being cancelled too early.
- [Instagram vs. LinkedIn: where should a B2B service business actually post?](https://clicknlikes.com/insights/instagram-vs-linkedin-b2b/): Roughly 4 out of every 5 B2B social leads come from one platform, which should settle where a small team's limited time actually goes.
- [How much should I actually budget for Google Ads?](https://clicknlikes.com/insights/paid-ads-budget/): Not a fixed number, a formula: what a realistic starting budget looks like once you know your industry's typical cost per click and your own conversion rate.
- [Why does a good website cost more than the cheap quote I was given?](https://clicknlikes.com/insights/cheap-website-cost/): The gap is rarely the design. It is almost always in what happens after launch: speed, structure and whether the site is actually built to rank.
- [How do I get more Google reviews without begging for them?](https://clicknlikes.com/insights/reviews-that-convert/): Review count is one of the most consistently weighted local-pack signals in the industry's own ranking-factor research. Here is the ask that actually works.
- [Does my business really need to post on social media every day?](https://clicknlikes.com/insights/social-every-day/): Platforms rewarded raw volume for years; the research behind 2026's algorithms favours 2 to 4 consistent posts a week over a daily habit that burns out by month two.
- [How much should a small business actually spend on marketing?](https://clicknlikes.com/insights/marketing-budget-small-business/): Three real benchmarks, from the SBA to Gartner, land between 7% and 9.4% of revenue, and the honest answer is which end of that range fits your stage.
- [Should you invest in SEO or Google Ads first?](https://clicknlikes.com/insights/seo-or-ads-first/): The honest answer depends on three things: your timeline, your margins, and whether you can wait for compounding.
- [Why your clinic needs to worry about ChatGPT, not just Google](https://clicknlikes.com/insights/ai-search/): AI answers name two or three businesses. Either you're in the answer, or you don't exist for that searcher.
- [The Google Business Profile mistakes costing you the local pack](https://clicknlikes.com/insights/gbp-mistakes/): Five fixable errors we find in almost every clinic and salon profile we audit.
- [How to write one blog post that ranks and gets cited by AI](https://clicknlikes.com/insights/blog-that-ranks/): The structure we use for every client blog, built for humans and language models both.
- [Your website is losing bookings before anyone even calls](https://clicknlikes.com/insights/3-second-test/): The three-second test we run on every client site before touching a line of code.
